42.87261,-71.29615: Robert Frost 1874-1963 Some of the best-loved poems in the English language are associated with this small farm owned by the poet from 1900 to 1911. Here Frost farmed , taught at nearby Pinkerton Academy and developed the poetic voice which later won him the Pulitzer Prize for Poetry four times and world fame as one of our foremost poets.
